# datadog_historical_metrics_configuration (Resource)

Provides a Datadog historical metrics configuration resource. It enables historical metrics ingestion for an existing custom metric. The presence of the resource enables historical metrics ingestion for the metric, and removing it disables ingestion. There is no update operation and the metric name cannot be changed, so changing the metric name destroys and recreates the resource. Managing historical metrics configurations requires the Historical Metrics Config Write permission.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Caller-assigned name sent as the create ID. Changing this value replaces the resource. After import, configure the canonical API ID as the name to avoid replacement. String length must be at least 1.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
